title: Registry Api Options Schema
description: Generates an HTTP api class (*.api.ts) under src/app/shared/api.

name.description: The name for the new api.
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for the api?

project.description: The name of the project where the api should be added.

path.description: The path where the api file should be created, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to src/app/shared/api.
